rules.name: Active Directory Domain Enumeration
rules.description: Detect AD enumeration via LDAP queries, DSQuery, BloodHound collection
rules.aql_query: SELECT * FROM events WHERE (URL_PATH IN ('/admin', '/phpinfo', '/.env', '/.git', '/wp-admin', '/server-status') AND RESPONSE_CODE IN (403, 404)) LAST 15 MINUTES
